claims: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
Earth Day was founded by U.S. Senator Gaylord Nelson in 1970.
Earth Day was founded following a major 1969 oil spill in Santa Barbara, CA.
Earth Day now rallies over 1 billion people worldwide through earthday.org and other organizations.
The 2026 Earth Day is Wednesday, April 22nd.
Common Earth Day activities include planting trees.
Common Earth Day activities include cleaning up litter.
Common Earth Day activities include volunteering.
Common Earth Day activities include reducing, reusing, and recycling.
